gap_severity_assessment.rationale: ZERO CereVasc patents explicitly address patient-specific or adaptive features. All 25 CereVasc active patents cover deployment methods, catheters, drug delivery, and general eShunt system claims. None disclose patient-specific sizing, adaptive valves, posture compensation, sleep-state adaptation, disease-progression ML, or closed-loop non-invasive ICP feedback.
gap_severity_assessment.verified_via_grep: Searched V72_COMPLETE_CLAIM_CORPUS.json for: patient.specific, adaptive, personaliz, posture, sleep, individualiz, customiz, threshold, patient.centric. 0 matches for all terms. Searched V72_PHYSICAL_MECHANISM_SEARCH.json for: length, diameter, curvature, sizing, geometry, specific patient. 0 matches for all terms.

PROTECTED_CORE_eShunt_system.description: Foundational endovascular CSF shunt — deployment method, shunt body design, drainage mechanism.

PROTECTED_ADJACENT_delivery_access.description: Catheter systems, deployment methods, loading/delivery systems.

KNOWN_BUT_UNPROTECTED_patency_verificati.description: Patency verification via contrast agent + imaging — closest existing CereVasc IP to monitoring, but uses exogenous contrast + imaging, not continuous patient-specific adaptation.

EMERGING_TECH_ultrasound_oct_navigation.description: Sensors for anatomical mapping during deployment (not monitoring).

DRUG_DELIVERY.description: Minimally invasive drug delivery to subarachnoid space.

DIRECTIONAL_STENT.description: Directional stent for accessing extravascular spaces.

CATHETER_SYSTEMS.description: Catheter systems and methods for medical procedures using catheters.

HYDROCEPHALUS_TREATMENT.description: General hydrocephalus treatment systems (overlap with PROTECTED_CORE).

patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.patient_specific_sizing: NONE — no CereVasc patent addresses patient-specific sizing or selection based on individual patient anatomy.
patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.adaptive_valve: NONE — no CereVasc patent addresses adaptive or programmable valves (these are saturated by Hakim, Codman, DePuy Synthes, Miethke prior art).
patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.posture_compensation: NONE — no CereVasc patent addresses posture-adaptive or gravity-compensating features.
patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.sleep_circadian_adaptation: NONE — no CereVasc patent addresses sleep-state or circadian adaptive drainage.
patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.disease_progression_ml: NONE — no CereVasc patent addresses ML-based disease trajectory adaptation.
patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.closed_loop_non_invasive_feedback: NONE — no CereVasc patent addresses closed-loop feedback from non-invasive ICP proxy.
patient_specific_adaptive_coverage_in_ce.patient_specific_venous_anatomy: PARTIAL — CereVasc's catheter systems (US12318564B2, US12485256B2) imply anatomical accommodation but do not specifically disclose patient-specific custom curved-tip geometry for venous sinus variants.

implication_for_territory_8.gap_severity: HIGH (1.0) — wide-open IP gap. Any surviving candidate mechanism constitutes a NEW IP position for CereVasc.
implication_for_territory_8.buyer_value: HIGH — patient-specific/adaptive features address well-known shunt failure modes (over-drainage, under-drainage, mismatched drainage profile) that drive revision surgeries.
implication_for_territory_8.novelty_threshold: MODERATE — even though components may be individually known (posture sensors, programmable valves, non-invasive ICP monitors), eShunt-specific SYSTEM-LEVEL integration is novel.
implication_for_territory_8.competitive_landscape: VIEshunt (2025) is direct competitor for smart shunt with IMU; Azygos Vascular has passive flow regulator patents. CereVasc does NOT have patient-specific/adaptive IP and is therefore at competitive disadvantage in this territory.

honest_disclosure: CereVasc IP corpus is well-mapped (87/128 claim-audited = 68% evidence coverage per V72_MOAT_MAP). The 0-match grep result for patient-specific/adaptive terms across V72_COMPLETE_CLAIM_CORPUS + V72_PHYSICAL_MECHANISM_SEARCH is a strong (but not 100%) indicator that CereVasc has no patient-specific/adaptive patents. The 32% unaudited patents (mostly JP/CN/DE foreign) are a residual risk that should be confirmed at V2.
